specs_json.compute: NVIDIA Jetson Orin (~100 TOPS) onboard AI

notes: Skydio's flagship autonomy-first drone (announced Sept 2023) with onboard NVIDIA-class edge compute for GPS-denied visual navigation and night autonomy via IR illumination. Carries a tri-sensor gimbal (zoom, telephoto, radiometric thermal) and optional attachments (spotlight, speaker/mic, parachute). Used heavily in DFR (drone-as-first-responder) and utility inspection; NDAA compliant.

failure_modes.name: Visual navigation degradation in low-texture darkness
failure_modes.symptoms: Autonomy warnings, refusal to fly obstacle-avoidance in dark without IR mode
failure_modes.mitigation: Enable NightSense/IR illumination, maintain GPS fallback, avoid featureless environments

failure_modes.name: Gimbal motor fault after hard landing
failure_modes.symptoms: Horizon tilt, gimbal error codes, blurry stabilization
failure_modes.mitigation: Post-incident gimbal calibration, transport in case, factory service for persistent errors

failure_modes.name: Battery cold-weather voltage sag
failure_modes.mitigation: Pre-warm batteries, keep >30% reserve in cold ops

failure_modes.name: Connectivity loss on 5G/LTE remote ops
failure_modes.symptoms: Video freeze, autonomous RTH/hover during DFR missions
failure_modes.mitigation: Configure lost-link behavior, multi-carrier SIMs, mesh/Connect antenna placement

failure_modes.name: Prop strike in confined-space inspection
failure_modes.mitigation: Use prop guards indoors, conservative obstacle margins, inspect props each flight

failure_modes.name: Thermal sensor NUC artifacts
failure_modes.mitigation: Allow warm-up, trigger flat-field correction, firmware updates
